AMCC-7099.summary: Data Not in Sync: Dashboard Widgets vs. Reports

testSteps.expectedResult: User is successfully logged into the application

testSteps.action: Navigate to Dashboard page with ID DASH-5521
testSteps.expectedResult: Dashboard loads successfully with all widgets visible

testSteps.action: Note the values displayed in WGT-1001, WGT-1002, WGT-1003 for date range 03/01/2025 to 03/31/2025
testSteps.expectedResult: Widget values are loaded and visible

testSteps.action: Navigate to Reports section and open RPT-3301 and RPT-3302 with the same date range and filters
testSteps.expectedResult: Reports load successfully with data for the specified date range

testSteps.action: Compare Total Revenue value from WGT-1001 against RPT-3301
testSteps.expectedResult: Values should match within an acceptable tolerance of 0.01%

testSteps.action: Compare New Customers value from WGT-1002 against RPT-3302
Compare Conversion Rate value from WGT-1003 against RPT-3302
testSteps.expectedResult: Values should match within an acceptable tolerance of 0.01%

testSteps.action: Trigger a manual data refresh on the dashboard and re-compare all values
testSteps.expectedResult: After refresh, all widget values should synchronize and match report values

expectedOutput.successMessage: All dashboard widgets are synchronized with the corresponding report data.

currentBehavior.errorMessage: Data discrepancy detected between dashboard widgets and reports. Widget values do not reflect the latest data available in reports.

errorMessages.syncFailureMessage: Dashboard widgets are out of sync with report data. Please refresh the dashboard or contact support.
errorMessages.dataMismatchAlert: Data mismatch detected for metrics: Total Revenue, New Customers, Conversion Rate.
errorMessages.refreshErrorMessage: Unable to sync dashboard widgets with latest report data. Sync failed at 04/15/2025 14:28:00.
errorMessages.staleDataWarning: Dashboard data is stale. Last successful sync was on 04/14/2025 08:15:42.

AMCC-7099.notes: This issue was identified during the March 2025 release cycle. The root cause is suspected to be a caching mechanism on dashboard widgets that does not invalidate properly when report data is updated. Verify that after a cache flush or forced refresh, widgets correctly pull updated values from the same data source used by reports.
